① OBSERVED (designer, friction-log entry #19): budget_report with no constraint_id was refused. Expected: one roll-up across every Constraint, "as closure_report's budgets leg must compute anyway". Cost: 1 refusal, and one call per budget to check all 14.

② PRECEDENT: cap:budget (BL-11) and cap:closure-report. No record of an all-budgets form or of this refusal.

③ CANDIDATES:
(a) Per-constraint by design, with no roll-up anywhere.
(b) A roll-up exists elsewhere and is not pointed to.
(c) The observation is wrong: an optional scope exists.

④⑤ MEASURED on the installed 0.74.0 in a scratch graph:
- budget_report's schema has `required: ["constraint_id"]` and only that property. So (c) is refuted.
- The refusal reads "`budget_report` was called without the required argument `constraint_id` — The Constraint (`con:…`) holding the limit to roll up against …" and names no other tool.
- closure_report's budgets leg does sweep every Constraint, but returns only swept/closed/worst counts ("budgets: 1 modelled, 0 with a declared margin"). There are no per-budget totals, worst paths or basis coverage.
So (a) and (b) are both partly true.

⑥ CLASS. A per-item reader, and a design-wide sweep built inside a different report with a thinner answer, with nothing joining the two. The same shape as "a population check has no served form".

⑦⑧ OWED: a design-wide budget_report form (every Constraint with total vs limit, basis coverage and verdict, bounded by the reply budget), or a refusal that names closure_report for counts. Plus a test that the refusal names the design-wide route.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: how often callers need all budgets at once, beyond this session.
